environment: Windows Sandbox with networking enabled, run as SYSTEM, Google SafeSearch confirmed in Edge by the operator
scope: F2 slice 2: forced SafeSearch through DNS CNAMEs, scheduled rules in the policy timezone, DNS cache flush on policy change

package.build: tools/build-msi-fixtures.ps1 -Production (no defines), WiX 5.0.2, version 0.3.0, agent and installer source at df4e212
package.fault_injection_actions: absent (CustomAction table checked inside Sandbox before install)

policies: Built at run time relative to UTC: version 1 with SafeSearch for google, bing, youtube and duckduckgo, timezone UTC, *.iana.org in a window open all of today and example.net in a window only on tomorrow's weekday; version 2 moves example.net into the open window. Digests are computed in PowerShell and checked against agent/policy.py by tests/test_safesearch_sandbox.py
checks: open schedule window blocks through system DNS while a closed one does not
search engines resolve through a CNAME to their enforced SafeSearch host
Google search in Edge shows SafeSearch locked on, confirmed by the operator
policy change flushes cached answers without restarting the service
removal restores NRPT rules, trust and hosts
operator_observation: Google SafeSearch settings page showed 'Filtro ativado' with a lock and stated the setting cannot be changed because an administrator controls the network
notes: The cache-flush check resolved example.net without clearing the DNS client cache, so the blocked answer after version 2 proves the agent flushed the stale upstream answer
Preflight confirmed the host neither filtered the fixture names nor enforced SafeSearch, so the CNAMEs came from the agent
Window edges at a real clock boundary are covered by unit tests with an injected clock, not by waiting in Sandbox
not_validated: YouTube, Bing and DuckDuckGo restricted modes in a browser (only their DNS CNAMEs were checked)
Physical endpoint, VPN clients and captive portals
DNS over HTTPS configured in browsers and other bypasses (F2 slice 3)
Real management server and panel warnings for agents without web-filter:v2
